wiese.eingabe: Opaque gouache storybook illustration, thick matte paint, visible broad brush strokes, rich warm colors, simplified shapes, no outlines. A plain gently varied meadow of short green grass seen from above at about 45 degrees, filling the whole picture edge to edge, soft lighter and darker green brush strokes, a few tiny pale yellow dots, nothing else, no path, no plants, no flowers, no bushes, no stones, no objects, no horizon, no sky. No text.
